title: Headway vs SonderMind: Therapist Network Comparison 2026
description: Compare Headway and SonderMind provider networks for therapists. See credentialing speed, reimbursement, features, and which platform is best for building your therapy practice.

summary.bottom_line: Both Headway and SonderMind are free-to-join therapist networks with insurance credentialing and billing. Headway has the largest network (70,000+ providers) with unique clawback protection. SonderMind offers VA partnership for 100% covered veteran therapy and premium reimbursement rate negotiations. Both are excellent options for building an insurance-based practice.

sections.heading: Headway vs SonderMind: Overview
sections.content: Headway and SonderMind are both leading platforms that help therapists accept insurance by handling credentialing, billing, and payments. Both are free for providers to join, taking a share of insurance reimbursements. Headway, founded in 2019 in New York, has grown to be the largest mental health provider network with 70,000+ credentialed therapists. SonderMind, founded in 2017 in Denver, differentiates with VA partnership (100% covered for veterans), Medicare acceptance, and an integrated telehealth platform.

sections.heading: Provider Economics
sections.content: Both platforms are free for therapists to join with no membership fees or subscription charges. They're compensated through a share of insurance reimbursements. Headway promises consistent payments and unique clawback protection - providers are paid even if claims are denied, charges disputed, or clients don't pay. SonderMind offers premium in-network reimbursement rates and same-day payment options. Payment schedules are bi-weekly for both (Headway: 15th and last day of month).

sections.heading: Key Differentiators
sections.content: Headway's unique clawback protection is a significant advantage - therapists are protected from insurance billing complexities. SonderMind's VA partnership allows therapists to serve veterans with 100% VA coverage at no cost to the veteran - available in all 50 states. SonderMind also accepts Medicare and Medicare Advantage, which Headway does not. SonderMind provides an integrated telehealth platform and mobile app, while Headway requires providers to use their own telehealth solution.

sections.heading: Platform & Support
sections.content: Both platforms handle the administrative burden of insurance credentialing and billing. SonderMind offers continuing education resources and a provider directory for client matching. Headway focuses on being the largest network with the most comprehensive payer coverage. Both are HIPAA compliant. Headway has SOC 2 certification. SonderMind's mobile app may be convenient for providers who prefer app-based practice management.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Both are excellent free options - consider your specific needs:

recommendations.when: You want to join the largest therapist network with proven clawback protection, ensuring you're paid regardless of claim complications
You want to serve veterans through VA partnership (100% covered) or need Medicare acceptance
You want an integrated telehealth platform and mobile app included rather than using separate tools
You prioritize the most comprehensive payer network and fastest credentialing (2-4 weeks)
You can join multiple networks to maximize client access and referrals - they're both free

faqs.q: Can I join both Headway and SonderMind?
faqs.a: Yes, you can join multiple provider networks since both are free. This can maximize your client access and referrals. However, you'll manage relationships with both platforms.

Headway promises consistent payments for care delivered and protects providers from clawbacks - even if claims are denied, charges disputed, or clients don't pay after sessions. This is a unique benefit not offered by most networks.

faqs.q: Can I see veterans through SonderMind?
faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind is an in-network VA provider. With a valid VA referral, therapy is 100% covered by the VA at no cost to veterans. This is available in all 50 states.

faqs.q: Which has faster credentialing: Headway or SonderMind?
faqs.a: Headway advertises 2-4 week credentialing, compared to 90-120 days when credentialing solo. SonderMind's credentialing timeline varies by payer and isn't as specifically advertised.
